run_learner_loop: run the learner_loop function to start the RL training loop with inference server and model updates
compute_metrics: compute the policy gradient loss, baseline loss, and entropy loss from learner and actor outputs
normalize_rewards: normalize rewards using running mean and standard deviation statistics with optional per-job tracking
trace_model: trace a trained PyTorch model to TorchScript format and save it along with serialized flags
checkpoint_save: save the model state dict, optimizer state, and scheduler state to a checkpoint file
